description: Retry the platforms that failed on a failed or partially_published post. Only failures classified transient (platform outage, rate limit, network) are re-queued; failures that need the user — reconnect an account, top up X API credits, choose TikTok visibility — or that the payload caused are refused and returned with their fix. Platforms that already went out are never re-posted. Check get_post → platformResults[].errorClass / .fix first.

id.description: Post ID with status failed or partially_published

name: retry_failed
